events.name: China Industrial Profits (Jan-Jun Y-o-Y)
events.description: Measures cumulative profit growth at large industrial firms, signalling corporate health and manufacturing demand in China.

events.name: Germany Ifo Business Climate Index
events.description: Surveys German firms on current conditions and expectations, a leading indicator for the Eurozone's largest economy.

events.name: US Consumer Confidence (Conference Board)
events.description: Tracks US household sentiment on jobs, income and inflation, an early signal of consumer spending strength.

events.name: US Advance Goods Trade Balance
events.description: Estimates the gap between US goods exports and imports for June, an early input into quarterly GDP calculations.

events.name: US Fed Interest Rate Decision
events.description: Sets the Fed funds target rate; guidance shapes expectations for borrowing costs, the dollar and global markets.

events.name: Australia CPI (Q-o-Q)
events.description: Measures the quarterly change in consumer prices; the RBA's trimmed-mean gauge is a key input for rate decisions.

events.name: US GDP (Q-o-Q, Advance)
events.description: First estimate of US economic growth for Q2, a key gauge of the economy's overall momentum.

events.name: UK BoE Interest Rate Decision
events.description: Sets the BoE's policy rate; the accompanying Monetary Policy Report signals the path for UK borrowing costs.

events.name: Japan BoJ Interest Rate Decision
events.description: Sets Japan's policy rate following 2026 hikes; the Outlook Report signals the pace of further tightening.

events.name: China Manufacturing PMI
events.description: Gauges factory activity via new orders, output and employment; a reading above 50 signals expansion in China's economy.
